message.content:
# Service Catalogue

## [Consultancy Name] — Data · Data Management · Automation · Artificial Intelligence

---

## About

We are a specialist consultancy helping organisations unlock the full potential of their data, processes, and intelligence capabilities. While our core expertise sits within the Microsoft 365 and Azure ecosystem, we are deliberately technology-agnostic where it serves you best. We assess, advise, and implement across a broad landscape of tools, platforms, and emerging technologies — always with a pragmatic, business-outcome-first approach.

Our services span four pillars: **Data**, **Data Management**, **Automation**, and **Artificial Intelligence**. Within each, we offer audits, strategic roadmaps, advisory engagements, and implementation of cutting-edge technology.

---

## Pillar 1 — Data

### 1.1 Data Audits & Discovery

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **Data Landscape Audit** | A structured assessment of where your data lives, who owns it, how it flows, and where the gaps are. We map data across M365 (SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Exchange), Azure services, on-premise systems, SaaS applications, and third-party platforms. |
| **Data Quality Assessment** | Evaluation of completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets. Includes sampling, profiling, and a scored remediation plan. |
| **Data Classification & Sensitivity Review** | Audit of how (or whether) data is classified, labelled, and protected. Benchmarked against your regulatory obligations (GDPR, UK GDPR, sector-specific frameworks) and Microsoft Purview / DLP capabilities. |
| **Shadow IT & Data Sprawl Audit** | Identification of unmanaged data stores, personal cloud accounts, and off-platform data silos that create risk, duplication, and blind spots. |

### 1.2 Data Strategy & Roadmaps

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **Data Strategy Roadmap** | A 12–36-month prioritised roadmap for data modernisation. Covers architecture, tooling, governance, skills, and investment phasing. M365-native solutions (Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Purview) are evaluated alongside best-of-breed alternatives. |
| **Analytics & BI Roadmap** | From spreadsheet chaos to governed, self-service analytics. We design the path through Power BI, Azure Synapse, Databricks, or open-source stacks — matched to your maturity, budget, and user base. |
| **Data Migration & Consolidation Plan** | Phased strategy for consolidating data from legacy systems, on-premise servers, and fragmented SaaS tools into a coherent, governed architecture. |

### 1.3 Data Advisory

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **Fractional Data Advisory** | Ongoing senior-level advisory (retainer or per-engagement) for data architecture decisions, vendor selection, governance model design, and regulatory compliance. |
| **Microsoft Fabric & Modern Data Platform Advisory** | Guidance on adopting Microsoft Fabric, its lakehouse architecture, OneLake, and the unified semantic model — including when Fabric is the right call and when it isn't. |
| **Cross-Platform Data Architecture Review** | Independent assessment of your data architecture regardless of vendor. We evaluate M365/Azure solutions against AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, and open-source alternatives to ensure you're not locked in by default. |

### 1.4 Cutting-Edge Data Technology

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **Microsoft Fabric Implementation** | End-to-end delivery of Fabric workloads: data engineering (Data Factory), lakehouse, data warehouse, real-time analytics, and Power BI semantic models. |
| **Real-Time & Streaming Data Pipelines** | Design and build of event-driven data pipelines using Azure Event Hubs, Azure Stream Analytics, or cross-platform alternatives (Kafka, Apache Flink). |
| **AI-Augmented Data Engineering** | Use of AI-assisted coding and schema tools (GitHub Copilot, Azure AI for Data) to accelerate pipeline development, data profiling, and documentation. |
| **Data Mesh & Data Product Implementation** | For larger organisations: designing and implementing data mesh / data product architectures with domain-aligned ownership, self-service platforms, and federated governance. |

---

## Pillar 2 — Data Management

### 2.1 Information & Records Management Audits

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **Information Governance Audit** | Comprehensive review of how information is created, stored, shared, retained, and disposed of across M365 and the wider estate. Identifies orphaned content, duplicate libraries, unmanaged file shares, and retention gaps. |
| **Records Management Compliance Audit** | Assessment against UK GDPR, Data Protection Act 2018, sector-specific retention schedules, and internal policy. Covers SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Exchange, and non-Microsoft systems. |
| **Collaboration & Content Audit** | Evaluation of Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive usage patterns: adoption, hygiene, permission sprawl, and the "digital hoarding" problem. |

### 2.2 Data Management Roadmaps

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **Information Governance Roadmap** | A phased plan to establish (or mature) an information governance framework: classification, retention, disposition, access control, and accountability. Tool-agnostic in design; M365 Purview as the primary implementation vehicle unless your context demands otherwise. |
| **Content & Collaboration Modernisation Roadmap** | Strategy for rationalising SharePoint sites, OneDrive structures, Teams channels, and external collaboration. Includes decommissioning, migration, and adoption plans. |
| **Data Lifecycle & Retention Roadmap** | Design of retention labels, disposition policies, legal hold strategies, and litigation-readiness processes. Covers M365 Purview, Azure Information Protection, and cross-platform records systems. |

### 2.3 Data Management Advisory

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **Governance Model Design** | Advisory on building or refining your data and information governance model: roles, policies, decision rights, and operating cadence. We advise on governance frameworks irrespective of the underlying toolset. |
| **Microsoft Purview Advisory** | Deep expertise across Purview's suite — DLP, Sensitivity Labels, eDiscovery, Communication Compliance, Retention, and Audit. We help you configure, tune, and operationalise it effectively. |
| **Cross-Platform Data Stewardship** | Advice on stewardship models, data ownership, and accountability when data spans multiple platforms (M365, Azure, on-premise ERP/CRM, SaaS). |

### 2.4 Cutting-Edge Data Management Technology

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **AI-Powered Content Management** | Implementation of AI-driven metadata extraction, auto-classification, and content enrichment using Purview's AI capabilities, Azure AI Document Intelligence, or cross-platform NLP tools. |
| **Automated Retention & Disposition** | Design and build of automated retention and disposition workflows that span M365 and non-Microsoft systems, reducing manual compliance burden. |
| **Unified Search & Discovery** | Architecture for federated search across M365, Azure, and third-party systems — using Microsoft Search, Azure AI Search, or open-source alternatives (Elasticsearch, Typesense). |
| **Data Lineage & Impact Analysis** | Implementation of data lineage tracking (Purview, Azure Data Catalog, or cross-platform tools) to support impact assessment, audit trails, and regulatory reporting. |

---

## Pillar 3 — Automation

### 3.1 Automation Audits & Process Discovery

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **Process & Automation Opportunity Audit** | Structured discovery of manual, repetitive, and error-prone processes across the organisation. We map current-state workflows, quantify hours and error rates, and score opportunities by impact, complexity, and feasibility. |
| **Power Automate Maturity Assessment** | Evaluation of existing Power Automate (cloud and desktop) usage: coverage, quality, maintainability, governance, and adoption. Identifies gaps and anti-patterns. |
| **Integration & API Landscape Audit** | Review of how systems currently exchange data — point-to-point scripts, middleware, APIs, or nothing at all. Identifies integration debt and modernisation opportunities across M365 and non-Microsoft systems. |

### 3.2 Automation Strategy & Roadmaps

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **Automation Strategy Roadmap** | A prioritised, phased roadmap for automation across the organisation. Covers process selection, tool selection (Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, iPaaS platforms, custom code), governance, and change management. |
| **RPA & Intelligent Automation Roadmap** | Strategy for deploying robotic process automation and intelligent document processing. Evaluates Power Automate Desktop, UiPath, Automation Anywhere, and AI-native alternatives based on your process portfolio. |
| **API & Integration Modernisation Plan** | Plan for replacing brittle integrations with a governed API-first or iPaaS architecture. Covers Azure API Management, Logic Apps, and cross-platform iPaaS options (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato). |

### 3.3 Automation Advisory

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **Automation Governance Advisory** | Design of automation governance: naming conventions, environment management, approval workflows, monitoring, and ownership models. Ensures automation doesn't become its own shadow IT. |
| **Process Engineering Advisory** | Senior-level advice on process redesign, BPR, and lean/six-sigma principles to ensure you automate the right processes — not just the easiest ones. |
| **Cross-Platform Automation Advisory** | Independent guidance on tool selection when your automation needs span M365, Azure, on-premise, and SaaS. We're not tied to a single vendor's automation stack. |

### 3.4 Cutting-Edge Automation Technology

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **AI Agent & Copilot Workflow Implementation** | Design and build of agentic workflows using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Agent Service, or cross-platform agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen). Agents that research, draft, classify, route, and escalate — not just trigger. |
| **Intelligent Document Processing (IDP)** | End-to-end IDP pipelines using Azure AI Document Intelligence, Purview, or cross-platform OCR/NLP services. From unstructured documents to structured, actionable data. |
| **Event-Driven & Serverless Automation** | Architecture and build of event-driven automation using Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Event Grid — or cross-platform equivalents (AWS Lambda, GCP Cloud Functions). |
| **AI-Assisted Process Mining** | Use of process mining tools (Power Automate Process Mining, Celonis, or open-source alternatives) to discover as-is processes, identify bottlenecks, and prioritise automation targets. |

---

## Pillar 4 — Artificial Intelligence

### 4.1 AI Readiness & Audits

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **AI Readiness Assessment** | A structured evaluation of your organisation's readiness to adopt AI: data maturity, governance, skills, regulatory exposure, cultural readiness, and infrastructure. Produces a scored maturity model and gap analysis. |
| **AI Use-Case Discovery & Scoping** | Facilitated workshops to identify high-value, feasible AI use cases across the business. We scope each for data requirements, model approach, risk, and expected ROI. |
| **Responsible AI & Governance Audit** | Assessment of AI governance maturity against the EU AI Act, UK AI White Paper, NIST AI RMF, and internal policy. Covers model risk, bias, transparency, human oversight, and accountability. |
| **Copilot & AI Tool Adoption Audit** | Evaluation of current Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Azure AI adoption: licensing, usage, effectiveness, and the gap between purchase and productive use. |

### 4.2 AI Strategy & Roadmaps

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **Enterprise AI Strategy & Roadmap** | A 12–36-month AI strategy covering use-case portfolio, build vs. buy vs. partner decisions, data foundations, governance, skills, and investment. M365/Azure AI is the primary vehicle; we evaluate and incorporate non-Microsoft AI capabilities where they're the better fit. |
| **Generative AI Strategy** | Focused strategy for GenAI adoption: responsible use policies, tool selection (Copilot, Azure OpenAI, or cross-platform), prompt engineering enablement, and phased rollout. |
| **AI Governance Framework Design** | Design of your AI governance operating model: policies, approval workflows, model lifecycle management, incident response, and regulatory compliance. |

### 4.3 AI Advisory

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **Fractional AI Advisory** | Ongoing senior-level advisory for AI strategy, vendor evaluation, regulatory compliance, and executive communication. Available as retainer or per-engagement. |
| **Microsoft 365 Copilot Advisory** | Deep expertise on Copilot for M365, Copilot Studio, and the broader Microsoft AI portfolio. We help you get real value from your investment — not just a licence. |
| **Cross-Platform AI Advisory** | Independent AI guidance when your needs extend beyond Microsoft. We evaluate and advise on OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock, open-source models (Llama, Mistral), and custom ML — always in the context of your full technology landscape. |
| **AI Regulatory & Compliance Advisory** | Guidance on navigating the EU AI Act, UK AI regulation, sector-specific AI rules, and internal AI policy. Covers risk classification, documentation, and audit trails. |

### 4.4 Cutting-Edge AI Technology

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **Copilot Studio & Custom Agent Build** | Design and development of custom AI agents and copilots for your business processes — using Copilot Studio, Azure AI Agent Service, or cross-platform frameworks. |
| **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Implementation** | Build of RAG pipelines that ground AI responses in your organisation's data. Covers Azure AI Search, Purview, vector databases, and cross-platform RAG architectures. |
| **AI-Powered Analytics & Insights** | Implementation of AI-augmented analytics: natural-language querying of data (Copilot in Power BI, Azure AI), anomaly detection, forecasting, and automated insight generation. |
| **Custom ML & AI Model Development** | For use cases beyond off-the-shelf tools: design and build of custom ML models, fine-tuned LLMs, and AI pipelines on Azure ML, Databricks, or cross-platform stacks. |
| **AI-Augmented Automation** | Integration of AI into automation workflows: intelligent classification, predictive routing, natural-language process triggers, and self-correcting automation loops. |

---

## Cross-Cutting Services

These services apply across all four pillars and are not tied to a single technology or vendor.

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **Technology & Architecture Advisory** | Independent, vendor-neutral advisory on technology selection, architecture design, and platform strategy. We're M365 specialists, but we'll tell you when a non-Microsoft solution is the better fit. |
| **Digital Transformation Roadmaps** | End-to-end transformation roadmaps that integrate data, automation, and AI initiatives into a coherent programme with clear business outcomes, dependencies, and investment phasing. |
| **Change Management & Adoption** | Strategy and delivery of user adoption, training, and change management for new data platforms, automation tools, and AI capabilities. Technology fails without people. |
| **Regulatory & Compliance Advisory** | Cross-cutting advice on GDPR/UK GDPR, data protection, AI regulation, sector-specific compliance, and audit readiness — regardless of the underlying technology. |
| **Skills & Capability Building** | Training, workshops, and enablement programmes for your teams: data literacy, Power Platform, AI literacy, automation design, and responsible AI. |
| **Vendor & Procurement Advisory** | Independent evaluation and recommendation of technology vendors, SaaS platforms, and AI providers. We help you ask the right questions and avoid vendor lock-in. |

---

## How We Work

**Engagement models:**

- **Audit / Assessment** — Fixed-scope, fixed-price. Typically 2–6 weeks. Delivers a findings report, maturity score, and prioritised recommendations.
- **Roadmap / Strategy** — Fixed-scope, fixed-price. Typically 3–8 weeks. Delivers a phased roadmap with business case, investment estimates, and delivery plan.
- **Advisory / Retainer** — Ongoing, flexible. Senior consultant available on a retainer basis for decision support, governance, and strategic guidance.
- **Implementation / Build** — Project-based. Design and delivery of specific solutions: Fabric workloads, Power Automate flows, Copilot agents, AI pipelines, governance frameworks.
- **Embedded / Fractional** — A senior consultant embedded in your team for a defined period, working alongside your staff to build internal capability.

**Our principles:**

- **Business outcomes first.** Technology is the means, not the end. Every recommendation traces back to a business need.
- **M365-first, not M365-only.** We lead with the Microsoft ecosystem because it's where most of our clients are, but we'll recommend the best tool for the job.
- **Pragmatic over theoretical.** We design for what your organisation can actually adopt, not what looks impressive in a slide deck.
- **Governance is non-negotiable.** Data, automation, and AI without governance create risk. We build it in from day one.
- **We build capability, not dependency.** Every engagement includes knowledge transfer so your team can operate and evolve the solution without us.

---

*This catalogue is a living document. As the technology landscape evolves — and it does quickly — so does our service offering. We'll always tell you when a new capability is genuinely worth adopting and when it's better to wait.*

---

*© [Year] [Consultancy Name]. All rights reserved.*
